entries.55e15b15cd54a7a2: To achieve its mission, "Enhancing time value through technology," and its vision, "Life infrastructure that connects the happiness of local communities," the company has set growth of the food delivery market and improvement of its competitiveness as its priority issues. Through steps such as introducing variable delivery fees (dynamic pricing), improving the accuracy of estimated delivery times, improving the quality of delivery and customer service, and expanding the lineup of partner stores, the company says it aims to realize "making delivery part of everyday life." Its priority issues include further expanding sharing delivery, securing couriers, improving delivery efficiency and increasing the number of active users.

entries.a022436c947dcbd2: This business operates the delivery specialist website and app 'DEMAE-CAN'. Users order products from partner stores through the app or website, and for restaurants without their own delivery function, delivery agents deliver the food under delivery agency services (sharing delivery). Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥39,721 million (down 21.2% year on year). The consolidated subsidiary DEMAE-CAN Communications Co., Ltd. provides services including customer center operations.

entries.c9e5ef9055d2cf79: The company sees the domestic food delivery market as having paused in growth as the COVID period subsided, following the sharp surge in demand during the spread of the novel coronavirus. Under these conditions, the company has set the goal of becoming the No.1 player in Japan through growth of the food delivery market and expansion of its share, and operates in the single segment of the DEMAE-CAN business.
